name: ConvTransposeOverlapS8
adaptation: Two-input/two-output-channel signed transposed convolution. Input X is NCHW [1,2,2,2] INT8, weights W are [2,2,3,3] INT8 indexed [input_channel,output_channel,kh,kw], and B is two INT16 biases. Stride is 2 in both axes; dilation is 1; padding and output_padding are zero; groups=1. Output Y is NCHW [1,2,5,5], all fifty signed INT32 values. Initialize each Y[c,y,x] to B[c]. Each X[k,h,w] contributes X[k,h,w]*W[k,c,i,j] to Y[c,2*h+i,2*w+j] for every output channel c and kernel index i,j. Overlaps add; kernels are not flipped, and biases are added once, not per contribution. No activation/requantization; all sums fit INT32. This fixed integer specialization retains the source transpose-convolution scatter and channel mixing.
